necessary_context.content: At query x in R^d the oracle returns f_p(y,x)=f(x)+sum_{i=1}^p D^i f(x)[y-x]^i/i!. An accepted-point gradient is additionally needed for the auxiliary update and can be obtained through this oracle.

necessary_context.name: Taylor oracle

necessary_context.applies_to: Selected Algorithm variant and outer-iteration statement
necessary_context.content: The selected extraction uses integer p>=2, a convex C^p function on R^d with Lp-Lipschitz pth derivative, Lp>0, Euclidean geometry, and an existing minimizer x*. Algorithm 1 starts at x0=y0=0. This extraction does not substitute p=1 into Section 3.3 expressions containing p-1 in denominators.
necessary_context.name: Selected higher-order regime

necessary_context.content: Equation (1) counts accepted outer iterations. Algorithm 1 line 4 requires an implicit pair and an exact regularized Taylor minimizer. Section 4 analyzes additional line-search queries. Its epsilon-or-accepted-step alternative is not itself a computable value-gap certificate when f(x*) is unavailable.
